title: Remaining-set conditional Lyapunov certificate
objective: Construct or falsify a subset-dependent matrix certificate W_R whose Bellman inequalities close at the C001 rate, using the exact Schur-loss recursion instead of a scalar sigma-only induction.
acceptance_checks: The state retains the actual remaining subset and prefix-dependent residual.
Every use of a principal-submatrix spectral floor is justified.
A scalar-only failed induction is recorded as a barrier, not recycled as a proof.
The conclusion states whether it proves the stronger A-energy inequality or only advances a conditional certificate.
